landing.title: Your school planner, all in order.
landing.lead: Organise homework and tests, record grades and find notes by subject. iPagell shows your upcoming deadlines and averages, on your phone or computer.
landing.featuresTitle: From deadlines to notes, a place for everything.
landing.feature1Text: Record grades and weights. See each subject’s average and progress without recalculating.
landing.feature2Title: Homework and tests in your agenda
landing.feature2Text: Add deadlines to the calendar and quickly find what to prepare in the coming days.
landing.feature3Text: Share activities and notes with classmates. Choose which activities to add to your own agenda.
landing.privacyText: Grades, absences and personal notes stay in your account. Class activities and notes are shared in the common space; activity completion stays personal.
landing.faq1Q: Does it replace the school's official system?
landing.faq1A: No. iPagell is a personal tool and does not replace official school communications.
landing.faq2Q: Can the class see my grades?
landing.faq2A: No. Grades, absences, personal notes and progress stay private. The class sees activities and notes shared in the class space.
landing.faq3Q: Can I use it on my phone?
landing.faq3A: Yes. iPagell works in the browser; in compatible browsers you can also add it to your Home screen.
landing.faq4A: You can view a diary already saved on this device. Pending personal changes try to sync when you reconnect; shared activities need a connection.
landing.opensource: Code and documentation are on GitHub.
landing.footer: An independent project, not an official school record.

install.safariStepsLabel: Add iPagell to the Home Screen with Safari
install.safariStepOne: In Safari, tap Share (or Page Menu → Share).
install.safariStepTwo: Scroll and choose Add to Home Screen.
install.safariStepThree: Turn on Open as Web App if available, then tap Add.
install.chromeSteps: In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu and choose Add to Home screen or Install app, if shown.
install.samsungSteps: In Samsung Internet, use the install icon in the toolbar or the Add to Home menu.
install.edgeSteps: In Edge, open the … menu and choose Add to phone, if available. This may create a Home Screen shortcut.
install.firefoxSteps: In Firefox, open the ⋮ menu and choose Add to Home screen. A shortcut will be created.

landing.metaTitle: Online school planner: grades, agenda and notes
landing.metaDescription: Organise homework and tests, record grades and absences, and keep notes by subject. Try the 1–6 grade average calculator without an account.
landing.feature4Text: Write and format your notes, find them by subject and export them as PDF or Markdown.
landing.stepsIntro: Your averages and deadlines take shape with the data you enter.
landing.step1Text: Choose a username and password, then keep the code for recovering access.
landing.step2Text: Start with basic subjects or add your own. You can customise your term later.
landing.step3Text: See your updated average or next deadline straight away in your planner.
landing.faq5Q: Can I try it without an account?
landing.faq5A: Yes: the grade average calculator is public and does not save the grades you enter. An iPagell account is needed to keep your planner and notes.
landing.faq6Q: Which grading scale can I use?
landing.faq6A: iPagell currently supports grades from 1 to 6, with optional weights. Changing the language does not change the scale.
